name: Behind The Camera
source:
A horror V.N. that revolves around a paranormal reporter and investigator that posts their investigations online as "Informative Videos". One day the protagonist and his friend who is also his assistant get a request to investigate a cabin in the woods in a small town near the mountains called Woodvail. Although when they get there they discover something far more macabre than spirits. It is now in their hands to discover the secrets of this town, who can they trust and how will this story end?

[From [url=https://kenny-snow.itch.io/behind-the-camera]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
恐怖片V.N.围绕一名超自然记者和调查员展开，他们将他们的调查结果发布到网上作为“信息视频”。有一天，主角和他的朋友（同时也是他的助手）接到一个请求，要调查位于伍德韦尔山附近的一个小镇的树林里的一间小屋。尽管当他们到达那里时，他们发现了比鬼魂更可怕的东西。现在，他们需要揭开这个小镇的秘密，他们可以信任谁，这个故事又将如何结局呢？

[来自[url=https://kenny-snow.itch.io/behind-the-camera]itch.io[/url]]
